Acme Cloud Storage gives your team unlimited, redundant, globally distributed object storage with automatic versioning, fine-grained access controls, integrated CDN, built-in encryption at rest and in transit, real-time analytics, webhook notifications, and a 99.999% uptime SLA — all on a flexible pay-as-you-go pricing model that scales with your business needs and integrates with every major development framework and CI/CD pipeline your team already relies on every single day.

Our platform is trusted by thousands of engineering teams worldwide who need reliable storage infrastructure they can count on for mission-critical workloads, including media streaming, machine learning datasets, database backups, software build artifacts, and long-term archival storage, all managed from a single unified console that requires no specialized training to operate effectively.

Get started today

Security

All data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher, with optional customer-managed keys, automatic key rotation, detailed audit logs, and compliance certifications including SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, and FedRAMP Moderate so your legal and compliance teams can sleep soundly knowing your data is protected at every layer of the stack.

Performance

With edge nodes in over 40 regions worldwide, average time-to-first-byte under 50ms, parallel multipart upload support, automatic tiering between hot and cold storage classes, and a globally distributed content delivery network, your users will experience consistent high-speed access to their files regardless of their location or the size of the objects they are downloading or uploading.

Pricing

Start for free with 5 GB of storage and 50 GB of bandwidth per month at no cost, then pay only for what you use with no minimum commitments, no long-term contracts, no egress fees within the same region, and volume discounts that kick in automatically as your usage grows beyond 10 TB per month, making Acme the most cost-effective solution for teams of any size.
